raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Adds `--sleep-mode-backend` to `EngineArgs` and the CLI so a sleep-mode backend registered by a plugin (RFC #34303) can be selected from `vllm serve` or `LLM(...)`. Fixes #63056.

## Claims

- `vllm serve --sleep-mode-backend <name>` and `LLM(..., sleep_mode_backend=<name>)` now set `ModelConfig.sleep_mode_backend`. Before this, the field existed but no engine argument reached it.
- The default stays `cumem`, so nothing changes for existing users.
- `docs/features/sleep_mode.md` gets a short section on choosing a backend.

## Validation

New unit test `tests/engine/test_arg_utils.py::test_sleep_mode_backend_arg` checks the default, the CLI parse and the value that lands on `ModelConfig`.

Before the fix (base `fdc5fde9d7`):

```text
$ python -m pytest tests/engine/test_arg_utils.py -k sleep_mode_backend
E       AttributeError: 'EngineArgs' object has no attribute 'sleep_mode_backend'
1 failed, 115 deselected
```

With the fix:

```text
$ python -m pytest tests/engine/test_arg_utils.py tests/v1/worker/test_sleep_mode_backend.py
125 passed
```

End to end on an RTX 4060 (8 GB, WSL2) with `facebook/opt-125m`. I registered a small backend that subclasses `CuMemBackend` and logs `suspend`/`resume`, then selected it by name:

```python
SleepModeBackendFactory.register_backend(
    "logging_cumem", "toy_sleep_backend", "LoggingCuMemBackend"
)
llm = LLM("facebook/opt-125m", enable_sleep_mode=True,
          sleep_mode_backend="logging_cumem", enforce_eager=True)
# generate -> llm.sleep(level=1) -> llm.wake_up() -> generate
```

```text
INFO [sleep_mode_backend.py:202] Using sleep-mode backend: logging_cumem
[toy backend] suspend(level=1)
[toy backend] resume(tags=None)
identical after sleep/wake: True   (greedy, 16 tokens)
```

With an unregistered name, the engine starts and the first sleep raises the factory's existing error:

```text
ValueError: Unsupported sleep-mode backend 'not_registered'. Registered backends: cumem, logging_cumem.
```

`ruff check` and `ruff format` are clean. `tools/pre_commit/mypy.py 3.11 vllm/engine/arg_utils.py` reports the same two errors (`dtype` at L511, `lora_dtype` in `create_lora_config`) on the base commit as on this branch, so this change adds none.

The test runs in the existing Engine Core Buildkite step (`pytest -v -s engine`), which already covers `vllm/engine/` and `tests/engine`.

## Details

- This follows the pattern of the neighbouring sleep-mode flags: a field that defaults to `ModelConfig.sleep_mode_backend`, `add_argument` from `model_kwargs`, and a pass-through in `create_model_config`. The help text comes from the existing `ModelConfig.sleep_mode_backend` docstring.
- The flag takes any string and has no `choices`. Plugin backends register when `load_general_plugins()` runs in `EngineArgs.__post_init__`, which is after argparse, so a fixed list would reject the backends this flag exists for.
- An unknown name is still only caught when the worker first creates the backend, as before. I left early validation out to keep this PR to the wiring; I'm happy to add a check after plugin loading if reviewers want it here.
- Choosing a non-`cumem` backend turns off `--sleep-mode-offload-cudagraph` (`vllm/config/vllm.py`). That is existing, documented behaviour, and the new docs section points to it.
- Not a duplicate: no open PR adds `sleep_mode_backend` to `arg_utils.py`. #58183 and #58066 read the config field but don't expose it. The issue author asked me to take this on in the issue thread.
- AI assistance was used to write this change. I reviewed every line and ran the tests and the end-to-end check above myself.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

files.patch:
@@ -169,6 +169,24 @@ llm = LLM("Qwen/Qwen3-8B", enable_sleep_mode=True, enable_nccl_comm_suspend=True
 
 or `vllm serve <model> --enable-sleep-mode --enable-nccl-comm-suspend`.
 
+#### Choosing a sleep-mode backend
+
+`sleep_mode_backend` selects how GPU memory is freed and restored. The default
+is the built-in `cumem` backend. Plugins can register other backends with
+`SleepModeBackendFactory.register_backend` from a `vllm.general_plugins` entry
+point, and you select one by name:
+
+```python
+llm = LLM("Qwen/Qwen3-8B", enable_sleep_mode=True, sleep_mode_backend="my_backend")
+```
+
+or `vllm serve <model> --enable-sleep-mode --sleep-mode-backend my_backend`.
+
+An unregistered name is not caught at startup; it fails the first time the
+backend is used, such as on the first sleep. CUDA graph offloading and
+`release_kv_cache_memory()` have their own backend requirements, described
+above.
+
 ### Online Serving
 
 To enable sleep mode in a vLLM server you need to initialize it with the flag `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1` and pass `--enable-sleep-mode` to the vLLM server.

@@ -357,6 +357,22 @@ def test_jit_monitor_mode_arg(mode):
     assert engine_args.create_observability_config().jit_monitor_mode == mode
 
 
+def test_sleep_mode_backend_arg():
+    """A plugin-registered sleep-mode backend can be selected from the CLI."""
+    parser = EngineArgs.add_cli_args(FlexibleArgumentParser())
+    engine_args = EngineArgs.from_cli_args(
+        parser.parse_args(["--model", "facebook/opt-125m"])
+    )
+    assert engine_args.sleep_mode_backend == "cumem"
+
+    args = parser.parse_args(
+        ["--model", "facebook/opt-125m", "--sleep-mode-backend", "my_backend"]
+    )
+    engine_args = EngineArgs.from_cli_args(args)
+    assert engine_args.sleep_mode_backend == "my_backend"
+    assert engine_args.create_model_config().sleep_mode_backend == "my_backend"
+
+
 def test_hf_token_get_kwargs():
     kwargs = get_kwargs(ModelConfig)["hf_token"]

@@ -791,6 +791,7 @@ class EngineArgs:
 
     generation_config: str = ModelConfig.generation_config
     enable_sleep_mode: bool = ModelConfig.enable_sleep_mode
+    sleep_mode_backend: str = ModelConfig.sleep_mode_backend
     sleep_mode_offload_cudagraph: bool = ModelConfig.sleep_mode_offload_cudagraph
     sleep_preserve_parameter_names: list[str] = get_field(
         ModelConfig, "sleep_preserve_parameter_names"
@@ -1039,6 +1040,9 @@ def add_cli_args(parser: FlexibleArgumentParser) -> FlexibleArgumentParser:
         model_group.add_argument(
             "--enable-sleep-mode", **model_kwargs["enable_sleep_mode"]
         )
+        model_group.add_argument(
+            "--sleep-mode-backend", **model_kwargs["sleep_mode_backend"]
+        )
         model_group.add_argument(
             "--sleep-mode-offload-cudagraph",
             **model_kwargs["sleep_mode_offload_cudagraph"],
@@ -2037,6 +2041,7 @@ def create_model_config(self) -> ModelConfig:
             generation_config=self.generation_config,
             override_generation_config=self.override_generation_config,
             enable_sleep_mode=self.enable_sleep_mode,
+            sleep_mode_backend=self.sleep_mode_backend,
             sleep_mode_offload_cudagraph=self.sleep_mode_offload_cudagraph,
             sleep_preserve_parameter_names=self.sleep_preserve_parameter_names,
